items:
'Salty Escape' is newly purchased and completely remodeled for 2021! Our home is located in the perfect location to everything at 360 Red Cedar Way. Our newly remodeled home includes 4 bedrooms, 3 1/2 bathrooms, (1 king bedroom/bathroom, plus 1/2 bath on the main level).

We are located just 1 block from Camp Watercolor and the WC tennis courts, and near the Seaside bike cut through. Our home is beautifully and spaciously laid out with a large open concept living room and kitchen, 10 foot ceilings downstairs, 9 foot ceilings upstairs and plenty of room to spread out. We also provide a complimentary 6 seater street legal golf cart and 4 adult bikes year round!

Our home has been completely furnished with new paint, new countertops, new furniture throughout, new bedding, lighting, decor, and all new patio furniture and a brand new custom bed swing. The house sits off the main road and has a nice grassy park area to play, or throw and kick a ball around. Also included in the park is a gravel spot specifically designed to play bocce ball.

Included in our home, our guests have full access to the newly renovated Watercolor Beach Club, Camp Watercolor, multiple community pools, playgrounds/parks, tennis center, trails, and many restaurants. Watercolor includes quaint streets, bike paths, nature trails, the Watercolor Boathouse with rental paddleboards, kayaks and so much more.

We have all the amenities for a great vacation on 30A and look forward to having your family anytime!

Sleeping Arrangements - Sleeps 10 in beds
Main Level:
1 Guest Bedroom - King bed with ensuite tiled walk-in shower
1/2 Bath - just off the living room

2nd Level:
1 Master Bedroom - King bed with oversized ensuite bathroom/soaking tub/walk-in tiled shower
1 Guest Bedroom - Queen bed with ensuite shower/tub combination
1 Bunk Room - 4 twin bunks

Home Includes:
6 seater street legal golf cart
4 adult bikes provided year round
10 wristbands with full access to all Watercolor Amenities

*Must be 25 years old to rent the property, no false reservations
*No Pets/No Smoking
*No Large Wedding Groups

Please reach out if you have any questions!
Thank you!
Nicole
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
